blocks.text: On the morning of August 26, Bal Bahadur Majhi, 50, was clearing firewood, rocks, and sand from the tunnel at the Rasuwagadhi Hydropower Project in Timure. The plant diverts part of the river into the tunnel and uses its steep drop to generate electricity. Then he heard what he described as explosions in the distance.
